```

  inferInstance

  rfl

CategoryTheory.Abelian.epiWithInjectiveKernel.{u_1, u_2} {C : Type u_1} [Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [Abelian C] :
  MorphismProperty C
```
***
The class of morphisms in an abelian category that are epimorphisms
and have an injective kernel.

```lean
CategoryTheory.Abelian.epiWithInjectiveKernel_iff.{u_1, u_2} {C : Type u_1} [Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [Abelian C]
  {X Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
  epiWithInjectiveKernel g ↔
    ∃ I, ∃ (_ : Injective I), ∃ f, ∃ (w : f ≫ g = 0), Nonempty (ShortComplex.mk f g w).Splitting
```
***
A morphism `g : X ⟶ Y` is epi with an injective kernel iff there exists a morphism
`f : I ⟶ X` with `I` injective such that `f ≫ g = 0` and
the short complex `I ⟶ X ⟶ Y` has a splitting.

```lean
CategoryTheory.Abelian.epiWithInjectiveKernel_iff.{u_1, u_2} {C : Type u_1} [Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [Abelian C]
  {X Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
  epiWithInjectiveKernel g ↔
    ∃ I, ∃ (_ : Injective I), ∃ f, ∃ (w : f ≫ g = 0), Nonempty (ShortComplex.mk f g w).Splitting
```
***
A morphism `g : X ⟶ Y` is epi with an injective kernel iff there exists a morphism
`f : I ⟶ X` with `I` injective such that `f ≫ g = 0` and
the short complex `I ⟶ X ⟶ Y` has a splitting.
